# Third-party code in `vendor/`

`neon-js-0.7.0-beta.js` is a minified ES module bundle of
[`@neondatabase/neon-js@0.7.0-beta`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@neondatabase/neon-js)
and its browser dependencies, built with `scripts/build-vendor.sh`. It is not edited by hand.
